note: The Business Agent Worker's deployed origin. Identity is verified at the edge by Cloudflare Access; rosters (OWNERS / STAFF / CLIENTS) and the Agnes model credential are configured on the worker itself and never ship with this site. For local development only, http://127.0.0.1:3300 (the `npm run dev:agent` loopback server) is accepted via the gitignored public/agent-config.local.json override, which is never present in production builds.
